typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int,int> pii;

const int MAXN = 15;
const int MAXT = 65;

int dir[4][2] = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
int node_id[MAXT][MAXN][MAXN];

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    LL cap, flow;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int u, int v, LL cap) : u(u), v(v), cap(cap), flow(0) {}
};

    int N;
    vector<Edge> E;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> d, pt;

    Dinic(int N) : N(N), E(), g(N), d(N), pt(N) {}

    void add_edge(int u, int v, LL cap) {
        if (u == v) return;
        E.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
        g[u].push_back((int)E.size()-1);
        E.emplace_back(v, u, 0);
        g[v].push_back((int)E.size()-1);
    }

    bool bfs(int S, int T) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), N+1);
        d[S] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(S);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == T) break;
            for (int idx : g[u]) {
                Edge &e = E[idx];
                if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                    d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.v);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[T] != N+1;
    }

        if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int &i = pt[u]; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge &e = E[g[u][i]];
            Edge &oe = E[g[u][i]^1];
            if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                LL amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                LL pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                if (pushed) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    oe.flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

        LL total = 0;

            fill(pt.begin(), pt.end(), 0);
            while (LL flow = dfs(S, T))
                total += flow;
        }
        return total;
    }

    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));

        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (dist[i][j] == -1 || dist[i][j] > t) dist[i][j] = INF;
        }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {

            if (grid1[i][j] >= '1' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {

        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int vy = i + dir[d][0], vx = j + dir[d][1];
